sources.title: 東京大學東洋文化研究所善本全文影像庫：2009記載之A/B公開範圍、全文連結判據與研究影像使用邊界
sources.provider: University of Tokyo Institute of Oriental Culture, first-party
sources.quality_notes: Official 2009 explanation describes 4630 listings (A4019 public full images, B611 partial public images) and no large-batch downloads/redistribution; official help requires per-item catalog detail '全文' link to establish image availability. The existence of an image service does not establish that Tokyo Oki 1827 item6403767830 or Kuraishi 1869 item6403148395 is indexed, A/B classified, digitized or publicly viewable. 2009 reported counts/policy not assumed current. No book-specific page, impression or target glyph inspected.
